summary: Gate 3 documentation fixes. install-nex-core.md step 8 describes the progress rail as the installer draws it (the bullet follows the setting being applied, then Install) and step 10 mentions the Screenshot button; its Verification section no longer lists those two as open mismatches, and gate report defect 14 points to the post-gate3 guide corrections. vm-power.md describes the install-media offer with generic boot wording. manage-controller.md states that Add host gives the host the certificates in the -tls-cert file as its trust anchors, recommends the server certificate plus its issuing CA, notes that a leaf-only file pins the certificate and that the chained case is not exercised, and warns not to start the old appliance after a replacement, quoting the new confirmation. storage-repositories.md Verification cites the gate row that walked steps 2-4. The Phase 2 gate report uses UTC-only dates, aliases the lab loopback port, redacts the local-time timestamp in the stale-VM capture, notes that check_docs --all was not in the pre-build runner, and adds a post-gate3 fixes section stating that a gate4 rebuild and full rerun follow.

guide.reason: Guide text is corrected to match the installer and Controller behavior observed on gate3 and the post-gate3 confirmation wording in web/src/managed.tsx (powerConfirmText).

api.reason: API impact: none. Documentation only; the Add host trust text describes the existing ca_pem field of the existing host enrollment push (internal/controller/addhost.go), which is unchanged.

roadmap.reason: Corrections to existing guide pages and a gate report; no feature is added, dropped or reordered.

state.reason: Documentation only; no setting, record or table is added.

verification.method: Not lab-verified. install-nex-core.md steps 8 and 10 were compared against installer/gui/nex-shell.c and the gate3 lab observations recorded in the gate report; vm-power.md step 5 against the offer text in web/src/managed.tsx; the manage-controller.md trust text against internal/controller/addhost.go (ca_pem is the -tls-cert file contents); the replacement warning quotes powerConfirmText in web/src/managed.tsx, verified by the simulated browser run of the main.tsx lane, not in a lab. The chained-certificate case and the new Start confirmation remain unwalked on real hosts; a gate4 rebuild and full rerun follow. The redacted capture was inspected after editing.
